pool.text: Francisco de Herrera Campuzano erected a small indigenous village known as Saint Lawrence of Aburrá.
Queen consort Mariana of Austria founded the Town of Our Lady of Candelaria of Medellín.
King Charles II of Spain issued a royal decree granting the Medellín coat of arms.
The National Congress named the city the capital of the Department of Antioquia.
Enrique Haeusler designed the Guayaquil Bridge in the city.
Carré came to town and was hired to design and build several new buildings.
Cine Colombia, the first movie distributor of the country, was founded in the city.
Museum El Castillo was built in medieval Gothic architectural style.
The Metropolitan Cathedral was completed in the city.
Medellín built its first airport named the Enrique Olaya Herrera Airport.
The bard Carlos Gardel died in the city in a plane crash.
Atlético Nacional professional football club was founded in the city.
University Museum, University of Antioquia, was created inside University City.
A tradition has continued in the Silleta Parade during the annual Festival of the Flowers.
The Second Conference of CELAM was held expressing a preferential option for the poor.
Museum El Castillo opened its doors to the general public.
Leonardo Nieto Jarbon founded a traditional house venue in Manrique.
House Museum Master Pedro Nel Gómez officially opened as a museum.
President Álvaro Uribe ordered the military to carry out Operation Orion.
Medellín won the Sustainable Transport Award alongside San Francisco.
